from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys,html
from urllib.parse import unquote,urlsplit
r=Path('docs/records/gpt6-agent-guidance-20261116');e=r/'evidence'
before=json.loads((e/'dedup-before.json').read_text())
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
expected={
'AGENTS.md':before['files']['AGENTS.md'].replace('  materially affecting correctness, compatibility, security or scope; continue\n  authorized work that does not depend on them.','  materially affecting correctness, compatibility, security or scope.'),
'docs/agent/VERIFICATION.md':before['files']['docs/agent/VERIFICATION.md'].replace('- Reuse passing results while their source, inputs and environment remain\n  applicable. Repeat checks when changes or unresolved concerns invalidate them.\n- Once required checks have applicable passing evidence, do not repeat or broaden\n  checks without a changed input, new requirement or unresolved concern. Assess\n  applicability using the reuse rules below; this does not waive required checks.','- Reuse passing results while their source, inputs, configuration and environment\n  remain applicable under the reuse rules below; do not repeat or broaden checks\n  without changes, a new requirement or an unresolved concern. Rerun affected\n  checks when applicability is invalidated. Required checks are not waived.'),
'docs/agent/REVIEWER.md':before['files']['docs/agent/REVIEWER.md'].replace('- Do not modify files or delegate. Rely on supplied test results unless a\n  specific concern requires independent reproduction; do not automatically\n  repeat the full suite.','- Do not modify files or delegate. Follow the test-evidence and reproduction\n  rules in the [review policy](REVIEWS.md#review-budget-and-context).')}
for n,s in before['files'].items():
 if n==str(r/'REPORT.md'):
  it=iter(Path(n).read_text().splitlines())
  assert all(any(candidate==line for candidate in it) for line in s.splitlines()),'historical report line changed'
 else:assert Path(n).read_text()==expected.get(n,s),n
for n,h in before['historicalEvidenceHashes'].items():assert sha(Path(n).read_bytes())==h,n
# Reuse the independently reviewed resolver; original negative controls are in initial.json.
source=Path('target/agent-guidance-validation/check.py').read_text()
ns=dict(re=re,html=html,unquote=unquote,urlsplit=urlsplit)
exec(source[source.index('def without_fences'):source.index('# Validator controls')],ns)
for n,s in expected.items():
 assert re.findall(r'```.*?```',s,re.S)==re.findall(r'```.*?```',before['files'][n],re.S),n
files=list(before['files'])+['docs/agent/REPORTS.md','docs/BEST-PRACTICES.md','docs/MISTAKES.md','docs/TASK-LIFECYCLE.md','tasks/README.md']
links=0;historical=[]
for n in files:
 for link in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',ns['without_fences'](Path(n).read_text())):
  if n==str(r/'REPORT.md') and link=='../../../prompts/REVIEWER.md':
   historical.append(link);continue
  assert ns['resolve_link'](Path(n).resolve(),link) is None,(n,link)
  if not urlsplit(link).scheme:links+=1
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],check=True)
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()
assert set(changed)=={'AGENTS.md','docs/PATTERNS.md','docs/agent/REVIEWS.md','docs/agent/VERIFICATION.md','prompts/REVIEWER.md'}
untracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines()
assert all(n=='docs/agent/REVIEWER.md' or n.startswith(str(r)+'/') for n in untracked)
out={'baseline':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'command':['python3','target/agent-guidance-validation/dedup.py',sys.argv[1]],'validatorSource':Path(__file__).read_text(),'exitCode':0,'localLinksChecked':links,'historicalLinkExceptions':historical,'sourceBindings':{n:sha(Path(n).read_bytes()) for n in files},'guidanceChanges':'Only three exact, approved consolidations; all other instruction text unchanged','historyChecks':'All previous report lines retained in order; all previous evidence bytes unchanged','previousEvidenceFilesVerified':len(before['historicalEvidenceHashes']),'executableFences':'unchanged','scope':'only approved guidance/record paths','lineChanges':{n:len(Path(n).read_text().splitlines())-len(before['files'][n].splitlines()) for n in expected}}
(e/(sys.argv[1]+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k not in ['validatorSource','sourceBindings']},indent=2))
guidanceChanges: Only three exact, approved consolidations; all other instruction text unchanged
